en.title: [Undergraduate-National Scholarship] Notice on 1st Application Period for National Scholarship for the 1st Semester of 2027
summary: Notice on the 1st application period for the National Scholarship for the first semester of 2027.

Target: All university students including new students, transfer students, readmitted students, and returning students (enrolled students (재학생) must apply during the 1st period in principle; partial registrants (부분등록자) within regular semesters and completed students (수료자) are not eligible).
Document submission and family member consent: November 24, 2026 (Tue) 09:00 – January 14, 2027 (Thu) 18:00.
How to apply: Apply via the Korea Student Aid Foundation (한국장학재단) website (www.kosaf.go.kr) or mobile app.
en.easyExplanation: The 1st application period for the 1st semester of 2027 National Scholarship is open. All university students including new, transfer, readmitted, returning, and enrolled students can apply, but partial registrants (부분등록자) within regular semesters and students who completed coursework without graduating (수료자) are not eligible. Applications must be completed via the Korea Student Aid Foundation (한국장학재단) website or mobile app by 18:00 on January 7, 2027.
en.target: All university students including new students, transfer students, readmitted students, and returning students (Enrolled students (재학생) must apply during the 1st application period in principle, and are ineligible if the relief application opportunity has already been used. Partial registrants (부분등록자) within regular semesters and students who completed coursework without graduating (수료자) are not eligible.)

author: 정지수
originalContent:
2027년 1학기 국가장학금 1차 신청 안내
□ 신청기간 : 2026. 11. 24.(화) 9시 ~ 2027. 1. 7.(목) 18시
※ 소득분위산정이 오래걸릴 수 있으므로 최대한 빠른 일자에 신청 요망!!
□ 서류제출 및 가구원 동의 : 2026. 11. 24.(화) 9시 ~ 2027. 1. 14.(목) 18시
□ 신청대상 : 신입생, 편입생, 재입학생, 복학생 등 모든 대학생
- 재학생은 국가장학금 1차 신청이 원칙이며, 2차 신청 재학생은 재학 중 2회에 한하여 구제신청이 자동으로 적용되어 심사 진행
(단, 구제신청 기회 기사용 또는 기타 탈락사유 존재 시 지원 불가)
- 정규학기 내 부분등록자 및 수료자의 경우 장학금 수혜 불가
- 타장학금 신청시 소득분위를 필요로 하는 경우가 많으므로 국가장학금 수혜가능여부와 관계없이 국가장학금 신청 권고!!
□ 소득분위별 지원금액은 장학재단홈페이지-장학금-국가장학금1유형-지원금액 참고 (https://m.site.naver.com/1BiHk)
□ 신청사이트 : www.kosaf.go.kr 및 모바일앱
□ 문의처 : 1599-2000
